ios.desc: Experience deep relaxation with our Meditation app. Set a custom meditation timer, journal your sessions, and track your progress and streaks. Find calm, build consistency, and deepen your practice

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built an iOS app to practice Trancendental Meditation

quotes.text:
I recently got into Transcendental Meditation and wanted a dedicated app to track my meditation progress and streaks. After searching, I couldn't find anything that specifically met my needs for TM practice tracking.
There is an official app from the Maharishi Foundation, but after trying to register, I was placed on a waitlist with no clear timeline for access. Rather than wait indefinitely, I decided to build the app I needed myself.

This is a simple personal project born out of necessity - I built it for myself first, but thought other TM practitioners might find it useful too
